name: Ring of Disharmony, Improved
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of disharmony except the wearer suffers a -10 penalty to his Perform checks.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse followed by casting shatter upon it, destroying the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of inspired performance, improved

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
